title: bn254-gt-dlp: (6,2) STNFS, re-optimised descent plan, run gate, log phase metered at 2^95: 2^94.679077749

claims.statement: Claim type: expected work. For the full-production bn254-gt-dlp target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns x with g^x=z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1+64/20000+(K/2^64)2^95.124877783 < 2^94.679077749 units (C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under heuristics H1-H4, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, H-SEP and H5 (proof.md section 9). Run gate: the attack first reads one fresh uniform 64-bit coin v and returns failure unless v < K = 13543176555931539175; this closed run costs 64 instructions, charged in every run. K is the least integer with (K/2^64) x 0.531207 >= 0.39 (K-1 fails). Both individual logarithms run under one combined phase meter of 2^95 units that aborts as failure, so the ledger charges the logarithm phase at 2^95 in every opened run; the descent recurrence (expected 2^93.887953 for the re-optimised 82-row plan of DESCENT.md) enters only success, through Markov P(cap) <= 0.462638, giving modeled opened-run success 0.531207 and overall success at least 0.390000. No robustness margin is claimed: the success bound reaches 0.39 at the modeled values of the stated premises. All preprocessing, failed trials, closed gates, aborts, verification and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized over other targets.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the field, collection, filtering and cost-ledger arithmetic, including revised PGF-envelope descent and finite ECM-separation assumptions; rebuild returns rounded draft declarations. Arithmetic passes do not establish production hypotheses. part=pgf recomputes alpha=.5 PGF envelopes at psi=0..0.8 step .01 on all862 downward-rounded raw-mu toy observations; part=porttoy redoes an exact whole ball or parent/child/control from fixed seeds. These are scoped toy checks, not production proofs. Default{} also replays all862 PGF observations. part=bw config0..3 replays seven-pad positive/negative diagnostics; part=adaptive_stats recomputes all171entered-node PGF strata; part=adaptive,side,root_seed,order regenerates bounded recursive whole-ball evidence. These do not establish production relation saturation or uniform conditional transfer. Default also replays all171adaptive observations with downward-rounded rawmu; censored root outcomes remain unknown. part=threshold verifies the judge counterexample and existing171 count tails for the corrected analytic inequality; it adds no empirical joint-law claim.
